title: FLA import: implement instance filter extraction
description: flash8-binary.ts warns 'instance filters are not imported'. Implement parsing of Flash 8 filter data from CPicSymbol instance records. Filters in the model: DropShadowFilter, GlowFilter, BlurFilter, BevelFilter, GradientGlowFilter, GradientBevelFilter, ColorMatrixFilter — all defined in packages/core/src/engine/types.ts. Map FLA binary filter records to SymbolInstance.filters[]. Cross-reference ruffle's FLA reading or JPEXS flacomdoc for the byte layout. Add assertions to flash8-import.test.ts using a fixture that has filtered instances (may need a new fixture).
